expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds bencode parsing (or the first milestone) with TODOs; no full client
expectations.evidence: Only milestone-1 scaffold written: bencode/bencode.go has every function as a stub — 'return nil, 0, ErrNotImplemented' with '// TODO: dispatch on the first byte', '// TODO: find the terminating 'e'', etc.; main.go says '// TODO(milestone 1): decode `raw` with bencode.Decode'. No tracker/handshake/download code exists; PROGRESS.md shows milestones 2-7 with empty Status cells. Final answer coaches ('What to write next — all TODOs live in bencode/bencode.go', 'Don't dump the solution') rather than implementing.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with concrete checkpoint: '**How to check it:** go test ./bencode/ # all green, including round-trip and error cases; go run . ubuntu.torrent # prints announce, name, length' and 'milestone 1 is done when tests are green and `go run .` prints a real torrent's name and length.'

expectations.text: B3: Describes bencode types: strings <len>:<data>, integers i<n>e, lists l...e, dicts d...e
expectations.evidence: 'It has exactly four types: `i42e` (integers), `4:spam` (byte strings: length, colon, bytes), `l...e` (lists), and `d...e` (dicts whose keys are always byte strings, sorted when encoding).' All four types with concrete examples.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: All 4 shell commands are non-installing: 'go version 2>&1; echo "---"; ls' and three runs of 'go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./bencode/'. All writes (go.mod, main.go, PROGRESS.md, bencode/bencode.go, bencode/bencode_test.go) are inside the project dir; agent noted 'Go 1.26.1 is available' without installing anything.
